experience.assistance: Prepared routes, physical contexts, generic exploration and consequence opportunities; no target is supplied to the common future query.

query.name: MI01_Q_202
query.attribution: Native command selects request physically; no Python query/answer callback. Common drive, transport, B private sample and reply readers are prepared. NOT a learned missing-information detector or general autonomous inquiry.

return.name: MI01_FASE_202
return.assistance: All possible content routes, fixed generic query and transformation law prepared before B responds. No private sign/expected action inspected by host.
return.tradeoff: These turn opportunities can divert the actual reply away from its original recipient route. No claim that the same matter supplies both destinations.

use.scope: Measured reply-to-decision circuit. A fixed transformation with learned content is not itself a learned strategy.
